title: WPMS/559/2001 of SMT. REKHA ARYA Vs VICE CHANCELLOR KUMAUN UNIVERSITY and ANOT

paras.text:
WPMS No. 559 of 2001
Hon'ble P.C. Verma, J.
 Heard learned counsel for the
petitioner.
 This is an application for recall of the
order dated 10.04.2001in civil writ petition
no. 559/2001. By order dated 10.04.2001 the
writ petition was dismissed as not passed.
Therefore, the application for recall of the
above order is misconceived as the petition
was not pressed by the learned counsel for
the petitioner. However, it is open for the
petitioners to move fresh writ petition.
 Subject is above, the application is
rejected.
(P.C. Verma, J.)
Dated:
26.07.2001
WPMS No. 559 of 2001

Hon'ble P.C. Verma, J.
 Learned counsel for the
petitioner, submits that he does
not want to press the petition
and the same be dismissed as
not pressed.
 The petition is dismissed as
not pressed.
(P.C. Verma, J.)
Dated:
10.04.2001
